captions.detailed: This is a tall, modern air fryer with a matte black outer chassis featuring side ventilation louvers. The front panel is divided into an upper control cluster with a continuous rotary selector knob over three small white push buttons, and a lower pullout cooking basket. The basket handle features a small red prismatic release latch. The cooking basket slides out smoothly along the depth axis, and the internal cooking cavity is hollowed out with realistic shell walls.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a modern tall air fryer with a side-vented body, a lower pullout basket, and a front control panel. The basket must slide prismatically on the depth axis, the selector knob should rotate continuously, the three preset buttons should be separate prismatic push controls, and the red handle release latch should slide prismatically within its housing.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main air fryer body using a hollowed-out box with side vents subtracted. The lower cooking cavity is hollowed out to accept the drawer. The drawer/basket is modeled as an assembly with a hollow container, a front face, a handle, and a red release latch. The control panel is built on the upper front face, featuring a cylindrical rotary knob and three small rectangular push buttons. Joints are defined for the prismatic sliding of the drawer (Y-axis), the continuous rotation of the knob (Y-axis), the prismatic pushing of the buttons, and the prismatic sliding of the latch.
